title: Processing Queue
desc: Monitor and control all background rendering and assembly jobs.
lede: The queue is mission control for background work — see what's running, what's next, and how long it'll take.
body:
In progress — the queue UI is being refined in Phase 12; behavior below is the target.
At a glance
  • Queue stats and ETA.
  • Per-job output metadata (duration).
  • Reorder, pause/resume, and clear.
  • Live updates over WebSocket.

Watching progress

See live stats and ETAs as jobs run. Progress comes from a central service, so the numbers are consistent across the app. See Progress Services.

Controlling jobs

Reorder, pause/resume, and clear jobs. Job history stays available for reference.

Live updates

The queue updates in real time over WebSocket — no refreshing to see the latest state.
